candidates.name: Paiute Elko Area Expansion Project (2015)

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release: 35 mi lateral, +22 MMcf/d, FERC CP14-509, in service 2015, Nevada.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not a separate row; P7856 is the 900 km Paiute main line and only 2024-2028 expansions are rows. 35 mi = 56 km new pipe. Exact route and diameter unconfirmed (EIA diameter blank); FERC docket CP14-509 not yet read.

candidates.name: Stagecoach Lateral (Central New York Oil & Gas)
candidates.sponsor: Central New York Oil & Gas (acquired from Tennessee Gas Pipeline, CP07-13/CP07-15)

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release: 24 mi lateral, 24 and 30 in, +487 MMcf/d, CP07-15, NY and PA, 2006.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Existing line sold by Tennessee Gas Pipeline in 2006; no GEM row (P0259 is the Tennessee system). 24 mi = 38.6 km. Whether the 24 mi is the full lateral or only the acquired part is unconfirmed; route not read.

candidates.name: Algonquin Tiverton Electric Expansion lateral

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release: 16 mi lateral, 30 in, +46 MMcf/d, CP99-46, CT and RI, 2000.

candidates.why_maybe_new: 16 mi = 25.7 km, just over the floor. No row; P0149 is the main line and P0150 the AIM expansion only. FERC CP99-46 not read, so length near the threshold is uncertain.

candidates.name: Kern River Apex Expansion Project

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release: 28 mi of new pipe (loops), 36 in, +266 MMcf/d, CP10-14, WY/UT/NV, 2011.

candidates.why_maybe_new: GEM tracks expansion loops as own rows; P0207 is the 1,717 km main line only. 28 mi = 45 km but spread over several loops; per-loop lengths unconfirmed. Starts in WY, so in slice.

candidates.name: GTN Carty Lateral
candidates.sponsor: Gas Transmission Northwest (for Portland General Electric Carty plant)
candidates.to: Carty Generating Station, Morrow County, OR

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release: 24.4 mi lateral, 20 in, +175 MMcf/d, CP12-494, Oregon, 2015.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No row; P0231 is the GTN main system only. 24.4 mi = 39 km. FERC docket not yet read for endpoints.

candidates.name: Xcel Energy Cherokee Natural Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Public Service Company of Colorado (Xcel Energy)
candidates.to: Cherokee Generating Station, Denver area, CO

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release: 34 mi lateral, 24 in, +189 MMcf/d, intrastate, 2014, Colorado, no FERC docket.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Intrastate; state regulator (Colorado PUC) filing not yet read. 34 mi = 55 km. Could be a Cheyenne Connector style line; no matching GEM row (P0359 is a different 112.7 km line).
